description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTMLAndHTML4, which extends another class and provides a method makeFixes() that specifies HTML tag and attribute transformations for XHTML and HTML4 standards within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTMLAndHTML4
classes.description: Class providing HTML tag and attribute transformation rules specific to XHTML and HTML4 standards within the HTMLPurifier library, particularly handling deprecated tags and attributes.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Defines and returns an array of transformations for HTML tags and attributes, including deprecated tags, deprecated attributes, and styling properties, for XHTML and HTML4 compliance.
